GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after the mare was found to have a superficial laceration to its offside hip and was passed fit to start. When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that horse did not feel as though it travelled strongly at any stage of the event and was disappointing in the manner in which it closed off. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m was steadied. Rider dropped his whip near the 200m. When questioned stated that he was instructed ride the mare in accordance with how it jumped, anticipating being in a forward position. He added that after beginning awkwardly, he elected to ride it with cover being mindful that it was stepping up to 1200m. He said that after settling further back than anticipated the mare did not relax and consequently was one-paced when under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast , Went Forward and led on rail x 1 length . kicked on well Straightening Up . $1.95 loomed at 200m but this Kept Going Far Too Well , soft in the end # led/good kick
